title: First electron affinities across period 3
caption: Gaining an electron releases energy for these atoms, most of all for chlorine, whose extra electron completes the 3p sub-shell. Phosphorus (3p³, half-filled) releases less than silicon: its value is less negative. Magnesium and argon form no stable 1− ion and are left out.
alt: Bar chart of first electron affinities, all negative: sodium −53, aluminium −42, silicon −134, phosphorus −72, sulfur −200, chlorine −349 kJ mol⁻¹.
description: Sodium −53, aluminium −42 and silicon −134 kJ mol⁻¹.
Phosphorus −72, smaller than silicon because its 3p is half filled.
Sulfur −200 and chlorine −349, the most exothermic.
